items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 18:1
items.html: The Malchut of the first restriction that illuminates in Atzilut by virtue of the clothing of the Gevura of Atik in the Sealed Brain is called Botsina deKardinus, as in Answer 16 above. And it was explained in Answer 12 that all the aspects of arousal and heating of the female waters are drawn only from the Malchut of the first restriction, and this arousal is called by the name 'beating' — that the Botsina deKardinus beats and arouses the Mochin to refine and raise female waters. (Page 319, Item 58).
